name: @hunyed15/claude-code-review
description: Independent read-only code review with the local Claude Code CLI, plus a project cockpit panel (where you are, what blocks you, the next step). Exposed as DSH tools with an in-app collab tab and a sidebar project page. Includes an internal ACP transport (auto-installed deps, no user ACP setup).
author: hunyed15

scripts.test: node test/tool-smoke.mjs && node test/panel-smoke.mjs && node test/client-smoke.mjs && node test/acp-smoke.mjs && node --test test/cockpit-count.test.js test/cockpit-reader.test.js test/cockpit-gates.test.js test/cockpit-next-action.test.js test/cockpit-panel.test.js test/cockpit-route.test.js test/cockpit-client-smoke.test.js && pwsh -NoProfile -File test/engine-gate.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -File test/engine-cache.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -File test/engine-round-guard.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -File test/engine-acp.ps1
